contains_contention_do_not_use_as_dispat: This table conflates two effects and must not be quoted as a CTA dispatch cost. The probe grows elements with grid (elements = grid * 1024), so the working set grows with CTA count and the measured rise contains memory contention as well as dispatch. A later probe that holds per-CTA work constant and varies only geometry (microbench/nvidia_a800/runtime/cta_dispatch/cta_dispatch_cost.cu) measures the pure dispatch cost at 226 ns for 108 CTAs against this table's 616 ns, a factor of 2.7; the remainder is contention, which belongs to the memory model rather than the launch model. This table remains valid only for what it was derived for: the bf16 binary task-class floor curve, whose probe has exactly this working-set growth and whose consumption is bounded by probe_block_threads.

probe.note: work per CTA is held constant so only CTA count varies; total traffic at grid 108 is about 650 KB, far from bandwidth-bound, so the rise is dispatch and contention

shape_facts.continuous_not_wave_quantised: grid 128 spanning two waves measures below grid 108, so cost grows with CTA count rather than stepping per 108-CTA round
